scope: Full normal Windows workload with identical WASM, flags, OS sampler and observer; only scroll presentation changed. No data/query reduction or forced GC. Not physical device or a budget pass.
functional_evidence: All 933 ranks/names, 77 goalie fallback, AX/printing, 120 Tab/reverse steps and terminal boundaries pass; maximum 40 mounted, normal document roughly2800px, internal full scroll range roughly67000px.

decision: Candidate peak exceeds matching control. No memory saving established; leave runtime experiment unadopted and restore published source.
